dedupe_keys.name: uganda transmission lines planned 2016 energy sector gis working group

description: This dataset from the Energy Sector GIS Working Group in Uganda maps the transmission lines that were planned for the country's grid in 2016, as line features. The working group produces geographic data to support decisions in Uganda's energy sector, and the layer is shared through its ArcGIS open data hub and republished on OpenAfrica. Coverage is national at line level and the values reflect plans as of 2016, posted on 11 August 2017. Downloads are offered as an Esri REST service, GeoJSON, CSV, KML and zipped Shapefile, free of charge under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: it is a snapshot of plans, not built lines, over nine years old, with no attribute list on the page read and no update schedule. It suits capacity planning and network flow studies of future grid expansion in East Africa, and as a layer for comparing planned with observed lines mapped in OpenStreetMap. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
